description:
SOBRE A VTEX

VTEX é a plataforma de comércio completa que proporciona mais eficiência e menos manutenção para organizações que buscam fazer investimentos mais inteligentes em TI e modernizar sua estrutura de tecnologia. Através da nossa abordagem pragmática, capacitamos marcas, distribuidores e varejistas com uma flexibilidade incomparável e soluções abrangentes, permitindo que invistam apenas no que oferece uma vantagem clara para o negócio e aumenta a lucratividade.

A VTEX é confiada por 2.400 clientes globais B2C e B2B, incluindo Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker e Whirlpool, operando 3.400 lojas online ativas em 43 países (dados do ano fiscal encerrado em 31 de dezembro de 2024).

Fundada no ano 2000, a VTEX tem uma trajetória de crescimento imbatível. Desafiando todas as probabilidades, estamos liderando a indústria de alta tecnologia e nos posicionando acima de gigantes do mercado. Estamos construindo um futuro extraordinário com mais de 1.300 colaboradores distribuídos por 25 localidades em 16 países da América Latina, América do Norte, Europa e Ásia. Para mais informações, visite 

Na VTEX, você trabalhará em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, colaborando com colegas incríveis. Se você tem força individual, junte-se a nós e, juntos, seremos imparáveis.

INCLUSÃO E ACESSIBILIDADE

Na VTEX, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e acreditamos que a inclusão é essencial para o nosso sucesso. Se você precisar de alguma adequação especial para participar do nosso processo seletivo, por favor, nos informe.

Buscamos uma pessoa analítica, comunicativa, e colaborativa para atuar na área de Controladoria da VTEX.

Aqui, você fará parte de um time dinâmico, que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo, o trabalho em equipe e a inovação. As a HSE Engineer, your mission is to support the company's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) department in its daily activities, aiming to ensure the safety and health of workers and preserve the environment in which the company operates. You will assist in fulfilling the commitments established in TechnipFMC's HSE policy.

Responsibilities include: identifying applicable legal requirements and planning for compliance, conducting HSE inspections and audits, issuing technical reports, investigating incidents, promoting HSE tools, and disseminating HSE practices to employees and contractors. title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Our mission is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality microservice architectures and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux kernel, virtualisation, storage and networking.

LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The successful candidate will have experience leading successful, collaborative engineering teams, and demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems and deep knowledge of Linux.

Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.

What you will focus on

  • Lead a team of remote engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Participate in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Work from home with global travel for 4 to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • You have experience programming in C and/or Go.

What we offer you


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join a deep-tech project developing AI-driven simulation software for advanced engineering and manufacturing industries.
The goal of this project is to accelerate hardware innovation through intelligent, high-fidelity simulations — enabling engineers to design, optimize, and manufacture products faster and smarter across domains like aerospace, energy, and automotive.

This role is ideal for a self-driven and proactive engineer who thrives in an evolving environment where not everything is structured or predefined. You'll work with a small, talented team on complex technical challenges, take full ownership of your deliverables, and have the freedom to shape solutions from concept to deployment.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python (FastAPI, REST API).
  • Build, containerize, and orchestrate services with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Implement GitOps workflows and contribute to CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate closely with frontend, AI/ML, and cloud engineers to integrate components smoothly.
  • Ensure solutions are secure, reliable, and scalable in AWS cloud environments.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code — and proactively suggest improvements across the stack.

Requirements

  • Expertise in Python, including FastAPI and REST API development.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes, Helm).
  • Familiarity with GitOps, CI/CD, and cloud deployments (AWS preferred).
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, testing, and performance optimization.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A self-sufficient, proactive mindset — comfortable working in a fast-moving, less-structured startup environment where documentation is still evolving.
  • Fluent in English.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with 3D geometry data or computational simulation.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure security and best practices in DevOps.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL (not required but useful).
  • Exposure to AI/ML or numerical simulation environments.

Who You Are:

  • Communicative and collaborative, able to explain ideas clearly.

  • Proactive and curious, taking ownership from problem to solution.

  • Flexible and adaptable — you see change as an opportunity, not a challenge.
  • Passionate about solving complex engineering problems with modern technologies.

Benefits

  • Choose your contract: B2B/C2C,
  • Unlimited working-from-anywhere policy,
  • Referral Bonuses,
  • Working on international projects

Our values
We are a company that seeks the best for both our employees and clients, reaching beyond expectations in turning dreams into reality. Our way of working is rooted in our core values (Integrity, Excellence, Proactivity, Innovation, and People), with an expectation that our future colleagues will make these their second nature in their everyday work and life. We don't ask for perfection, but we do appreciate people motivated to better themselves in every conceivable aspect.

About IT Labs

Founded in 2005, IT Labs is an international software tech company, specializing in purpose and process-driven teams for high-performance, innovation, transformation, and efficiency. Our HQ is in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, and we have teams and offices around the world - the US, the UK, the Netherlands, Argentina, Brazil, Serbia, and North Macedonia. We are constantly growing, and we would love for you to become part of our team

Job Description Summary:

For 136+ years The Coca-Cola Company has grown to become the most recognizable brand in the world. In 2020 we launched the Alcoholic Ready to Drink (ARTD) brand Topo Chico Hard Seltzer in Latin America.

Due to the category growth, we are expanding our product innovation and looking for pioneers that know how to expand their thinking and bring new ideas to life. 

In this role you will be responsible for creating and executing a strong finance strategy within the Zone/Franchise to drive growth and profitability. This is an exciting opportunity for a Finance Director for ARTDs in South Zone to act as an intrapreneur to build and lead a "start-up" in Latin America with the resources and backing of The Coca-Cola Company.

What You'll Do For Us

  • Manage ARTD co-owned brands: budget, price and performance management (PPM).

  • Support end-to-end ARTD business planning.

  • Partner with ARTD Finance Operations Lead to support Franchise team and bottlers activities with financial expertise at the Franchise Unit level, to drive alignment across multiple stakeholders, and to develop the key insights needed to inform strategic priorities.

  • Manage all Business Models and Margins within the Franchise.

  • Develop and implement Margin optimization strategy across the entire value chain.

  • Revenue Growth Management.

Qualification and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Business, or related. An MBA or related master's degree is nice to have.

  • +7 years of leadership experience in senior financial planning or senior commercial finance roles.

  • Ability to work in a complex and matrixed network across Latin America

  • Ability to understand and anticipate the impacts of business strategies across the Coca-Cola system.

  • Strong communication skills (storytelling) evidenced by good verbal/written presentation and ability to partner and influence effectively with stakeholders.

  • Must be fluent in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

What We Can Do for You

  • Iconic & Innovative Brands: Our portfolio represents over 20 different billion-dollar brands such as Coca-Cola, Sprite, Fanta, Powerade, and more. We believe the Alcohol category will become a billion-dollar category for the Company. This is your opportunity to be a leader building that category across Latin America

  • Creative Team Culture: Be inspired by the best brand leaders and agencies in the world, which creates a creative culture that supports taking risks and innovation. 

  • Exposure to World Class Leaders: Availability to global marketing leaders that will expand your network and exposure you to emerging digital platforms and marketing insights.  

  • Community of Belonging:  We're an organization that believes in our ability to continually grow and build the right atmosphere where people feel safe and empowered, lets you bring your best self to work.  

  • Purpose Driven:  Purpose driven approach that empowers our people to protect the environment and communities we serve while delivering safe & quality products.   

Skills:

Agile Methodology, Business Analytics, Business Processes, Communication, Data Management, Finance Strategy, Financial Analysis, Financial Forecasting, Financial Reporting and Analysis, Group Problem Solving, Leadership, Storytelling, Strategic Thinking, Waterfall Model

Our Purpose and Growth Culture:

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what's possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

title: Civil Engineer with Python Experience
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as an AI Tutor in Civil Engineering, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Generate prompts that challenge AI.
  • Define comprehensive scoring criteria to evaluate the accuracy of the AI's answers.
  • Correct the model's responses based on your domain-specific knowledge.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

  • You hold a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD Degree in Engineering and/or in relevant area.
  • You have at least 3 years of professional experience with focus in one of the following fields: Structural Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, Construction Engineering and Management, Urban and Regional Planning, Civil Engineering Materials Science, Coastal and Ocean Engineering, Earthquake Engineering, Surveying and Geomatics, Hydraulic Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Public Health Engineering, Sustainable Engineering.
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above.
  • Proficiency in Python, with experience using libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, and Pandas.
  • Strong ability to design creative and diverse problems, particularly those that are computationally intensive and go beyond simple parameter modifications.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $14/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Descrição da empresa

John Crane, uma empresa do Smiths Group, é líder global em soluções de controle de fluxo de missão crítica para indústrias de energia e processos que permitem operações eficientes e sustentáveis. Nossos produtos incluem selos e sistemas mecânicos, acoplamentos, rolamentos, sistemas de filtragem e tecnologias de monitoramento digital preditivo. 

Temos uma rede global de mais de 200 locais em mais de 50 países e empregamos mais de 6.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Estabelecemos parcerias com nossos clientes para ajudá-los a manter suas operações seguras, reduzir o tempo de inatividade, melhorar a eficiência e atender aos mais recentes padrões ambientais.

Servimos milhões de pessoas todos os anos, ajudando a criar um mundo mais seguro, mais eficiente, produtivo e mais bem conectado em quatro mercados globais: energia, segurança e defesa, espaço e aeroespacial e industrial em geral. title: Analista de Projetos
description:
ATIVIDADES

  • Realizar tarefas de alta complexidade, sendo o responsável por orientar e revisar a execução de atividades e tarefas operacionais relacionadas a estruturação, gestão e monitoramento de planos de ação, análise crítica de problemas complexos envolvendo os projetos, com proposição de soluções e implementação de melhorias em padrões e processos;
  • Responsável pela análise crítica dos projetos, avaliando se os recursos (pessoas, tempo, recursos financeiros, materiais, etc...), a organização, a definição das ações e prazos gerências nos aspectos operacionais das equipes de projeto, tanto na elaboração dos planejamentos de recursos, como no acompanhamento, reavaliação, replanejamento das atividades das equipes, além de fornecer elementos para as justificativas dos desvios, quando houver;
  • Recomendar estratégias e tecnologias de execução, otimização de escopo e duração, promover a disseminação de novas tecnologias e melhores práticas;
  • Responsável pela análise crítica da elaboração, desenvolvimento, gestão, controle, revisões e monitoramento das demandas de projetos da Gerência Executiva, incluindo a projetização dos planejamentos do PMB (até 90 dias), Planejamento Tático (18 meses), Companhas de UMS, Paradas Programadas e Nâo Programadas, planos de contratação, planos de suprimentos de materiais, entre outros.

ESCOLARIDADE

  • Graduação: Administração, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Direito, Economia, Análise de Tecnologia da Informação, ou Administrador de Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas afins;
  • Pós-graduação: Gerenciamento de Projetos ou outras áreas correlatas à especialidade desde que validada pela gestão contratual.

REQUISITOS

  • Gerenciamento de Projetos: Experiência de 7 (sete) anos comprovada em gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Gestão de Processos: Experiência em Mapeamento de Processos com utilização do Bizagi Modeler, com conhecimentos sólidos em metodologias e técnicas de gestão de processos, como o BPM (Business Process Management) e Lean Six Sigma (certificação Yellow Belt ou superior). Isso inclui entender os conceitos de mapeamento e modelagem de processos, análise de fluxos, identificação de gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Experiência em elaboração de apresentações gerenciais: Capacidade de preparar e apresentar relatórios de progresso e resultados de projetos para a alta gerência, demonstrando clareza e confiança;
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Habilidade de comunicar-se claramente com todas as partes interessadas, incluindo equipe, clientes e fornecedores;
  • Gestão de Conflitos: Aptidão para identificar e resolver conflitos dentro da equipe de forma construtiva, mantendo um ambiente de trabalho harmonioso e produtivo;
  • Liderança de Reuniões: Experiência em conduzir reuniões eficientes, mantendo o foco nos objetivos e assegurando a participação ativa dos membros da equipe;
  • Apresentações Gerenciais: Capacidade de preparar e apresentar relatórios de progresso e resultados de projetos para a alta gerência, demonstrando clareza e confiança.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Experiência em gerenciamento de projetos com utilização do MS Project: Capacidade de criar, monitorar e ajustar cronogramas de projetos complexos, garantindo a entrega dentro dos prazos;
  • Certificação em PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PRINCE2 (Projects in Controlled Environments).

title: tec servicos offshore iii
description:
Job Purpose


Responsible for planning, executing, and coordinating activities related to the operations/installation of equipment produced by TechnipFMC for national and international clients. This includes participating in the development of operational installation procedures, in collaboration with the team, to ensure that operations/installations are carried out in accordance with operational procedures, safety standards, and client requirements.

Job Description


· Participate in briefing meetings with the coordination team regarding the planning of the operation to be carried out, in order to understand the procedures, resources, guidelines, and clarify any doubts.

· Contribute to the creation of databases for field occurrences and deviations by providing information to the integrated SAP system (S1), suggesting actions and measures to eliminate anomalies.

· Review documentation from previous operations through reports and study the procedures related to the upcoming operation, in order to be prepared to perform the assigned activities.

· Participate in the development of operational procedures (OP) for the client Petrobras, detailing the specific steps of the operation to be carried out, aiming to obtain STO validation (client support), which will be shared with other stakeholders.

· Receive, inspect, and verify the equipment mobilized and demobilized from offshore operations by checking the material lists, to ensure the system is intact and complies with all technical specifications, submitting this control to the client when requested.

· Perform equipment assembly and testing based on TechnipFMC and client procedures, using the necessary resources to initiate operations.

· Operate equipment according to operational procedures and safety standards, aiming to meet the demands of TechnipFMC and its clients.

· Prepare weekly activity reports on SharePoint, detailing the tasks performed each day, in accordance with the established deadlines and content requirements, to ensure the provision of information for time-off tracking, additional payments, and departmental cost control.

You are meant for this job if:



• Mechanical Technician Diploma;


• Active CFT registration; 


• Fluent English;


• Knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint);

Offshore experience in well completion and intervention, leadership position for hardware scope.
Proven experience in installation/intervention (workover) of subsea equipment using EDP, LRP, UEH, and HPU (SCVS/DPR):

  • Tubing Head (THD)
  • Tubing Hanger (TH)
  • Subsea Christmas Tree (ANM)
  • Tie-in, UTH, and SDH, among others.

At Consilium Safety, we don't just create technology—we deliver solutions that protect people, assets, and the planet. As a global leader in fire and gas safety, we serve critical industries including marine, energy, rail, and construction. With over 100 years of expertise and 55 offices worldwide, we combine deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge innovation to shape the future of SafetyTech.

Job Summary
We are looking for a Service Coordinator based in Rio de Janeiro. The Service Coordinator is responsible for planning, organizing, and monitoring service activities, including customer support cases, warranty matters, and Annual Performance Tests (APT). You will ensure that all service operations run efficiently and consistently, maintaining the highest standards of customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond to customer inquiries within 24 hours.
  • Plan and schedule service engineer attendances in line with the Consilium After Sales handbook and customer requirements.
  • Prepare and deliver accurate quotations for service activities.
  • Collect, store, and manage all service-related documentation in Consilium CRM and local servers.
  • Review service documentation and generate final customer invoices within seven days of completion.
  • Ensure necessary spare parts are prepared, allocated, and delivered for service attendances.
  • Maintain CRM records and adhere to company processes for service cases, NCRs, FAQs, and other mandated procedures.
  • Assist in training colleagues and external customers as required.
  • Promote safety awareness, contributing to accident prevention and maintaining a clean, organized workspace.
  • Conduct physical inventory counts as needed.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Preferred Education & Experience

  • High school diploma required; relevant degree or certification preferred.
  • Proficient in English (written and verbal).
  • Well-organized, quick learner, and able to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Strong decision-making skills in a fast-paced technical environment, with a focus on customer satisfaction.

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for career growth within a dynamic, expanding organization.
  • A diverse and inclusive culture that values teamwork and creativity.
  • Make a meaningful impact on the safety of industries worldwide.

Apply Now
If you're ready to learn, contribute, and grow, apply today and help us shape the future of SafetyTech.

title: Global Head of GSI Alliances
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We have created a new senior leadership role, Head of Global System Integrator (GSI) Alliances, to lead our business development and partnership with these important actors in the global technology sector. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we are expanding into the enterprise market where GSIs provide significant operational and tactical capacity. We have had good success with GSIs that are delivering next-generation private cloud, container, and public cloud solutions built with Canonical Ubuntu, and are looking to expand our investment in these alliances.

Reporting to the VP Global Alliances and Channels, the Global Head of GSI Alliances will lead a team of representatives and develop that strategic go-to-market strength for Canonical. You will work closely with GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver opensource solutions at scale for their enterprise customers. In this role you will be responsible for ensuring that our solutions are used or embedded at the core of GSI digital transformation platforms.

Our GSI team builds trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increases Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizes the partnership and leads all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. The Global Head of GSI Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all GSI partners, as well as promotion of our GSI related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and GSI related events (including Canonical s yearly GSI executive summit).

Location: Our company largely works from home, this role can be based in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

  • Own and drive GSI partner strategy, forecast, bookings and revenues for Canonical
  • Lead and evolve a team towards accelerated revenue growth with GSI
  • Build strategic relationships with partners at executive levels
  • Guide our offering from product management, to product marketing, and scale it through the support of our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you:


The successful GSI Alliance Sales Director will have :

  • Experience in alliance and indirect sales management roles
  • Experience in the GSI sector
  • Deep commercial experience encompassing revenue and margins
  • Proven leadership and presentation skills
  • Insight into open source, Ubuntu and Canonical's competition and opportunities
  • Track record of data-driven decision-making
  • An autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Lead Golang Software Engineer at any seniority level, who strives for the highest engineering quality, seeks improvements, continuously develops their skills, and applies them at work. This is an exciting opportunity to work with many popular software systems, integrations technologies, and exciting open-source solutions.

The Commercial Systems unit is conceived as seven engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business and Golang plays an integral role in it. We are looking for software engineers for these teams:

The Billing team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that provides a standardized and scalable capability to turn metrics into billable amounts, enable customers to see their current spend with Canonical at any time, and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely billing. The service further integrates with other engineering, business, payment systems. This team is an excellent match for any software engineer interested in growing their skills in the billing and payment processing domain.

The Contracts team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that will become the single source of truth for all contracts with all customers. The service provides a standardized CPQ capability and stores signed contracts in a structured format. The service further integrates with other engineering and business systems including a CRM system and an accounting system. This team is an excellent match for any software engineer interested in understanding sales and revenue processes and growing their skills beyond software engineering.

The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches. This team is a great opportunity for a software engineer interested in security and with a strong focus on engineering quality and reliability.

The Ubuntu Pro backend team designs and develops backend services for the delivery of Ubuntu Pro, the most comprehensive subscription for open-source software security. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based backend components, while the Security team at Canonical develop security patches. This team is a great opportunity for a software engineer with a strong focus on engineering quality, software performance, and reliability of operations.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region (all teams except for Ubuntu Pro) or the AMER region (Ubuntu Pro).

title: Linux Cryptography and Security Engineer
description:
This is a unique opportunity to use your software engineering and cryptography skills to build and maintain the security foundation that enables Ubuntu and its users to operate securely and remain compliant to international information security standards such as FIPS 140-3 and Common Criteria.  You will use your applied cryptography, Linux Security, and coding skills to enhance the Ubuntu distribution and work with organizations such as DISA and CIS to draft and implement security hardening benchmarks for Ubuntu.

As a member of the Security Hardening team you will work with and develop automation tooling to audit deployed systems for DISA-STIG and CIS benchmark compliance. You will interact with internal and external stakeholders to identify gaps in our frameworks, and develop new solutions to address these challenges. In this role you will have the opportunity to influence team and security culture, facilitate technical delivery, and help drive team direction and execution. You'll collaborate closely with Canonical's kernel team as well as the wider engineering organization to drive features impacting all Ubuntu users.

Day-to-day responsibilities

  • Collaborate with other engineers in the Security Hardening team to achieve and retain various Security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components (OpenSSL, Libgcrypt, GnuTLS, and others) with the features and functionality required for FIPS and CC certification
  • Collaborate with external security consultants to test and validate kernel and crypto module components
  • Work with external partners to develop security hardening benchmarks and  audit + remediation automation for Ubuntu
  • Contribute to Ubuntu mainline and upstream projects to land solutions and benefit the community
  • Communication and collaboration within and outside Canonical to identify opportunities to improve our security posture, rapidly resolve issues, and deliver high-quality solutions on schedule

What we are looking for in you

  • Hands-on experience with low-level Linux cryptography APIs and debugging
  • Excellent software engineering fundamentals, including prior experience with C development, and the ability to demonstrate such
  • Hands-on experience with Linux system administration and shell scripting
  • Demonstrated knowledge of security and cryptography fundamentals + direct experience writing secure code and implementing best practices
  • Significant development experience working with open source libraries
  • Excellent verbal and written communications to enable efficient collaboration with internal and external partners in a remote-first environment

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Prior experience working on FIPS/Common Criteria certified products and in-depth knowledge of the underlying standards
  • Prior experience working directly with DISA-STIG or CIS benchmarks, including related audit + remediation tooling (e.g. Compliance as Code)
  • Experience working directly with Linux Kernel
  • Prior experience with Python, OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language), and Ansible
  • History of contributions to open source projects

What we offer you


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Operações HSE Sênior
description:
*Contexte et environnement *
O Brasil é um país altamente regulado, com exigências rigorosas de SSMS e necessidade de demonstração de gestão de riscos às autoridades como pré-requisito obrigatório para qualquer operação. A TotalEnergies EP Brasil é uma afilial estratégica para o Grupo, em fase de crescimento (200 mil bpd em participação do Grupo até A excelência na gestão de riscos operacionais contribui para a expansão do portfólio operado e para o aumento da influência sobre os parceiros responsáveis por ativos estratégicos operados por terceiros (OBOs). A excelência em SSMS, Segurança e Integridade garante a sustentabilidade da reputação da TotalEnergies no Brasil, ao mesmo tempo em que preserva a vida de todos os envolvidos.

*Activités
Realizar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios do OneMAESTRO, visando preservar o meio ambiente e os recursos, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e descarbonização dos ativos da empresa. *

  • Participar de estudos de perigos e avaliações de riscos para garantir a execução segura dos programas operacionais.
  • Aconselhar e aprimorar o reconhecimento de perigos e o controle de riscos nas mudanças de gestão.
  • Participar diretamente na implementação dos Programas de Segurança da TotalEnergies EP Brasil.
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões de planejamento e coordenação das atividades diárias, reuniões semanais e de pré-turno "toolbox".
  • Promover e incentivar o conceito de "Visita de Campo Gerencia em Conjunto" (Management Joint Safety Tour/Boots on the Ground).
  • Garantir, por meio de auditorias periódicas, que o sistema de Permissão de Trabalho (PTW) dos contratados esteja sendo gerenciado e executado de forma segura e correta.
  • Dar assistência, aconselhar e aprimorar as análises de causa raiz de incidentes e incidentes com Alto Potencial.
  • Participar ativamente da elaboração das "Análises de Segurança das Atividades" dos contratados relacionadas à execução das atividades.
  • Garantir a participação ativa na organização de reuniões de segurança pré-trabalho, com atenção especial para:
  • preparação de operações de içamento,
  • prevenção de queda de objetos,
  • prevenção de lesões nas mãos,
  • operações simultâneas e
  • operações críticas.
  • Auxiliar e aconselhar para garantir os prazos e acuidade dos relatórios de eventos, incidentes, acidentes e anomalias.
  • Garantir o monitoramento da performance de HSE e benchmarking relacionados os KPIs atualizados, conhecidos e acompanhados.
  • Auxiliar e aconselhar no aprimoramento da competência e treinamento das equipes em HSE (empresa e contratados).
  • Garantir os prazos e acuidade ao reportar os eventos de HSE no sistema OneSynergi.
  • Fornecer treinamentos específicos de HSE no campo, conforme necessário, garantindo a inclusão de toda a supervisão dos contratados.
  • Verificar a aplicação da política de HSE e dos documentos de referência relacionados, incluindo os procedimentos da TotalEnergies EP Brasil e as Regras de HSE do Grupo TotalEnergies.
  • Desenvolver Documentos de Integração com Contratados (Bridging Documents) e garantir que sejam compreendidos, relevantes e utilizados nas atividades de execução dos programas.
  • Auxiliar e aconselhar o Gerente de Operações HSE.
  • Auxiliar, aconselhar e aprimorar os meios de identificação de perigos e controle de riscos em operações simultâneas (SIMOPS) e/ou situações degradadas.
  • Dar suporte no gerenciamento e na comunicação de forma eficaz ao pessoal de campo sobre ações corretivas relacionadas a acidentes, inspeções, auditorias e revisões.
  • Realizar auditorias e inspeções para garantir o devido alinhamento com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE da TotalEnergies e com o OneMAESTRO.

Responsabilidades:

  • Aconselhar e auxiliar o Gerente de Operações HSE na aplicação da política de HSE e na execução eficaz dos programas de trabalho definidos.
  • Comunicar e implementar os programas de HSE em instalações industriais.
  • Participar ativamente da metodologia de melhoria de processos.
  • Contribuir para a disseminação da filosofia de HSE e para o treinamento do pessoal operacional.
  • Manter uma imagem profissional, ações e expertise técnica em todos os momentos.

*Profil du candidat *

  • Formação superior em HSE (por exemplo: Engenharia de Segurança, Engenharia Ambiental, Higiene Ocupacional).
  • Experiência na área de SSMS em atividades de E&P em Instalações de Produção Offshore e/ou Unidades de Perfuração.
  • Competências pessoais: organizado(a), capaz de lidar com altos níveis de estresse, capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e com abordagem multidisciplinar (alto nível de transversalidade), além de liderar e motivar equipes.
  • Comunicação e adaptabilidade em ambiente multidisciplinar.
  • Fluência em inglês e português.
  • Conhecimentos obrigatórios em informática: Excel, Word, PowerPoint.

*Informations supplémentaires
TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats. *

title: Internal Audit and Controls Analyst
description:
Job Purpose


The Internal Audit and Controls Analyst will be responsible for conducting audits and testing controls to ensure compliance, drive process improvements, and safeguard the integrity of financial controls across TechnipFMC's global locations. This role provides assurance to senior management, presents findings, and supports strategic initiatives while leveraging advanced digital tools and analytics to enhance audit practices.

Job Description

  • Conduct testing of financial, operational, and IT controls to validate compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Evaluate and improve the effectiveness of internal controls and risk management procedures.
  • Prepare audit reports and present findings to management, recommending corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement control improvements.
  • Support the development and maintenance of policies and procedures related to internal controls.
  • Advise management on controls during the OneERP SAP S/4 HANA transition to support compliant integration.
  • Facilitate training and communication initiatives to improve efficiency, risk management, and assurance practices across the organization.
  • Propose actionable recommendations to improve operational effectiveness and address control weaknesses.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
  • experience in internal audit, controls, or risk management.
  • Familiarity with audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal control frameworks (e.g., SOX)
  • Knowledge of Accounting standards and principles, including month end closing processes
  • Understanding of current accounting (GAAP & IFRS) and auditing frameworks (COSO, COBIT, IIA Standards, etc.)
  • Fluent in English

title: Professor(a) Escola Técnica Roberto Rocca
description:
1.-Finalidade da Posição

  • Os professores da Escola Técnica Roberto Rocca têm o propósito de oferecer uma formação de alto nível.
  • Eles devem promover os princípios da instituição, utilizar estratégias de aprendizagem inovadoras e dominar os conhecimentos e procedimentos técnicos de suas disciplinas, com a finalidade de contribuir para a formação pessoal e profissional dos estudantes.
  • Ser membro de um colegiado docente que compartilhe experiências e gere conhecimentos.
  • Seu papel é criar experiências educacionais que envolvam os estudantes de forma ativa e conectem as aprendizagens com outras áreas de seu desenvolvimento.
  • Para o docente ETRR, o desenvolvimento de todos os estudantes é relevante, por essa razão, além de sua função docente, também deve ser coach, facilitador e mentor acadêmico.

2.1 Principais Processos e Tarefas (Específica)


Funções Funcionais do cargo:

  • Favorecer ambientes de aprendizagem ativos, utilizando técnicas, estratégias e recursos pertinentes que permitam inovar e promover a aprendizagem significativa dos estudantes.
  • Planejar o processo de formação a partir de uma perspectiva social, epistemológica, psicopedagógica e institucional que permita a gestão do conhecimento.
  • Participar ativamente em comunidades e redes de aprendizagem que permitam socializar experiências para melhorar a prática educacional.
  • Refletir sobre o processo de formação realizado, a partir das avaliações docentes, administrativas e de estudantes que favorecem a melhoria contínua do processo.
  • Atualizar-se constantemente nas áreas técnicas, pedagógicas e tecnológicas que permitem estar na vanguarda com as tendências do mundo global e fazer frente às necessidades sociais existentes.
  • Apropriar-se dos valores da instituição dentro e fora dela, com a finalidade de ser um modelo a ser seguido pelos estudantes, docentes e pessoal administrativo.
  • Ser tutor, assessor e mentor dos estudantes, fazendo o devido encaminhamento ao pessoal correspondente em situações que estiverem fora de seu alcance, com a finalidade de proporcionar um desenvolvimento integral aos estudantes no contexto profissional e pessoal.
  • Documentar intervenções educacionais inovadoras que permitam fortalecer as estratégias de ensino-aprendizagem da instituição.
  • Propor alternativas, programas e projetos que potencializem a formação dos estudantes, com a finalidade de fortalecer a prática educacional.
  • Aplicar as ferramentas a serem utilizadas para o fim de aceitar a admissão de Alunos a partir da perspectiva psicopedagógica.

Pré-requisitos:


Buscamos profissionais com experiência em ambientes escolares e formação superior completa nas áreas de Engenharia ou Tecnologia, conforme o perfil de cada disciplina:

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades.

Sobre a Skidun

A Skidun é uma agência com 17 anos de história, referência em branding, posicionamento estratégico e construção de audiência. Atuamos com marcas como NBA, Sportv, Adidas, Vasco, Goodyear, UFC, Globoplay, Multiplan, entre outras.

Descrição do emprego

Estamos buscando um braço de conteúdo para a Skidun: Para acompanhar o time no dia a dia, transformar bastidores e projetos em narrativas relevantes, e garantir presença constante e coerente da marca nas redes.

  • Organizar a agenda de gravações e convidados.

  • Coordenar e revisar o pós-produção (edição, cortes, títulos e legendas).
  • Publicar os episódios completos e cortes em todas as plataformas.
  • Gerar insights e desdobramentos para novos conteúdos a partir dos episódios.

2. Bastidores:

  • Registrar bastidores, conversas, reuniões e momentos autênticos dos sócios e do time.
  • Criar vídeos no estilo "reality de bastidores", transformando situações reais em conteúdo leve e inspirador.
  • Adaptar os registros para diferentes plataformas (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts), utilizado formatos criativos.

3. Always On:

  • Produzir e publicar conteúdos semanais de autoridade e engajamento.
  • Criar e editar formatos próprios (como os carrosséis de conteúdo e vídeos curtos com ganchos fortes).
  • Monitorar trends e adaptar formatos em alta para a linguagem da Skidun e de seus sócios.
  • Trabalhar com pautas oportunas ("ângulos" de temas do momento) para reforçar a autoridade da marca e conectar com os produtos e serviços.
  • Apoiar na criação de conteúdos com o time interno (quando fizer sentido mostrar os bastidores da agência).

Job Description Summary:

Job Summary

As RGM & Hubs Execution Lead, you will be responsible for leading the Revenue Growth Management (RGM) strategy and ensuring its flawless execution across ARTD. You will drive pricing, portfolio, and promotional discipline, while adapting commercial strategies to local hubs, with a special focus on the Central Zone Hub. Your mission is to balance profitable growth with executional excellence, ensuring the right value equation for consumers, customers, and the system.

Scope

  • OBPPC (Occasion, Brand, Package, Price, Channel): Define and deploy the right portfolio and price strategy across ARTD, ensuring the correct pack-price architecture by occasion and channel.
  • Get & Set Price: Guarantee execution of pricing strategies, balancing competitiveness and profitability in all markets.
  • Price Increases & Promotions: Design and implement disciplined pricing and promotional plans to maximize revenue and value creation.
  • Innovation Execution: Ensure innovation projects are successfully executed in-market, with proper pricing, visibility, and promotional support.
  • Price Execution Discipline: Drive system alignment and field execution of price and promotional guidelines to ensure consistency across channels.
  • Hub Central Zone: Hub Central Zone : Dedicate 30% of the role's focus to the Central Zone Hub, adapting and tailoring commercial strategies to local realities and ensuring excellence in execution.

Impact

  • Value Creation: Deliver a sustainable and healthy value equation through disciplined portfolio, pricing, and promotions.
  • Commercial Performance: Contribute directly to top-line and margin growth of ARTD through effective RGM execution.
  • Execution Excellence: Be the system leader in ensuring price and promotion strategies are implemented consistently across markets and hubs.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or related field.
  • 7–9 years of experience in Revenue Growth Management and portfolio management.
  • Proven track record in leading OBPPC, pricing execution, and promotional strategies.
  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, and execution skills.

Core Competencies:

  • Ability to influence and negotiate with senior stakeholders across bottlers and commercial teams.
  • Leadership in translating RGM strategies into market execution.
  • Strong project management, governance, and disciplined follow-up.
  • Clear and effective communication with cross-functional and external partners.
  • Communication: Frequent influence and negotiation with bottlers and commercial stakeholders.

Skills:

Accountability, Business, Channels Strategy, Customer Relationships, Leadership, Price Management, Profitable Growth, Sales, Teamwork

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what's possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

title: Partner Sales Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. 

We are hiring a Partner Sales Manager to be a key contributing team member within the growing Dell alliances organization. Large OEM or Independent Hardware Vendor (IHV) brands - Dell, HPE, IBM, Lenovo, Ericsson, Cisco, Fujitsu and many more - are major partners for Canonical. These companies build software-defined solutions to capitalize on global open source mandates and associated macro trends. Canonical's flagship product, Ubuntu, and its broader open source portfolio are key ingredients for these partners to realize their aspirations. Canonical represents the best platform for rapid open source innovation.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Alliances - Dell, the Partner Sales Manager will work closely with Dell and Canonical teams in various geographies to enable Dell teams, generate and transact opportunities, drive a Canonical agenda within Dell, and achieve targeted results. They are responsible to build trusted relationships with Dell, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelize the partnership and drive business interactions from across persona - from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements as coordinated by the Senior Director.

The role entails

  • Build strategic relationships and enable Dell teams on the partnership
  • Build pipeline and transact opportunities through Dell 
  • Grow Dell's awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem
  • Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person
  • Align and support internal canonical field teams - identify, support, grow, transact
  • Expand existing footprint with Dell customers with an aim to upsell to broader portfolio
  • Support and contribute to broader strategy, initiatives and key campaigns as defined by the Senior Director

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals
  • Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Team player with superior accountability and customer support skills
  • Credibility and working knowledge of Dell - its products, go-to-market motion, and field
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and track record of operational excellence
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • Hands on experience with and Google Suite a plus

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer


We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Rust Engineering Lead
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Rust Engineering Leads of all levels of experience to drive the adoption of this exciting language into the full range of Canonical offerings, starting with Ubuntu but also our own projects and open source offerings. We see Rust as an important new language for system level services and capabilities, and a natural evolution path for the sort of software that would traditionally have been written in C or C++. We believe that there is an opportunity to rethink the foundations of future Linux systems with Rust as a central driver of change in everything from the system firmware and embedded software, bootloaders, up through the kernel and input handling, all the way to the desktop. 

We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Rust development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development.

This job posting is our general process for Rust engineers of all levels of seniority, for all relevant teams at Canonical. Apply here if you are an exceptional software engineer who prefers to work in Rust. After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests.

Canonical has substantial projects in Python, Go, C, C++ and we are starting to invest in Rust. For front-end development we prefer React and Flutter.

Join us in our mission to deliver innovative open-source solutions to individuals and enterprises around the world. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully home-based and distributed environment. These roles require extensive personal experience with Linux - the more different versions of Linux the better

Location: we have open roles for Rust engineers in every time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement well-tested and well-documented software in Rust
  • Advocate for Rust adoption in Canonical and upstream projects
  • Identify projects and codebases that could be prioritised for Rust adoption
  • Debug and fix issues encountered by your users
  • Participate in our engineering process through code and architectural reviews
  • Collaborate with community and colleagues on technical specifications
  • Seek improvements to engineering and operations practices
  • In some cases, deploy and operate services developed by the team
  • Contribute to the success of your product through technical advocacy

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • For more senior roles, experience building, deploying, and operating distributed systems and APIs
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Well-organised, self-starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Experience designing and writing high-quality Rust software on Linux
  • Experience with and passion for Linux at the system level

title: Field Service Technician
description:
Job Summary:

The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries, such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. In this position, the Field Service Technician (FST) offers real-time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment.

The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites. Our team of Field Service Technicians is the face of Flowserve and we rely on them to provide world-class service to our customers, creating a lasting competitive advantage for our products and services.

Responsibilities:

  •     Perform direct, in-person service calls in response to customer requests;

  •     Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly;

  •     Work side-by-side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required;

  •     Supervising the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly;

  •     Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule;

  •     Checking equipment before commissioning and start-up and evaluating performance during and after equipment start-up;

  •     Monitoring the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment;

  •     Guide customers on proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products;

  •     Collaborate effectively with Flowserve support organizations, including repair centers, customer service and sales engineering;

  •     Maintain and submit organized and accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged;

  •     Other duties as assigned;

Requirements:

  •     Mechanical Technician with active CFT;

  •     Experience as a Field Service Technician in a refinery industry;

  •     Knowledge of industrial applications and operations of pumps, valves, seals, actuators and mechanical equipment;

  •     Experience in installing mechanical equipment;

  •     Experience in repairing pump equipment, installing mechanical seals, changing seal faces, gaskets, rings, etc..;

  •     Knowledge of mechanical adjustment by backlash and interference;

  •     Knowledge of metrology and the use of measuring instruments such as pachymeters, external and internal micrometers, tubular micrometers, dial gauges and dial gauges;

  •     Proven ability to read and correctly interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;

  •     Good Outlook, Word and Excel skills;

  •     Intermediate English

  •     An active driver's license with a good driving record is essential for the job;

  •     Willingness to travel and ship, including globally, for long periods;

  •     Willingness to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers;

  •     Proven ability to correctly read and interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;

Desirable Skills:

  •     Advanced English and/or intermediate Spanish desirable;

  •     Professional certifications in this area.

title: Billing Analyst II
description:
About Us
Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.
We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.
We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.
It's a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit. 

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Deliver pro forma invoicing, pre-approvals, SES, etc.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.

title: Analista de Engenharia
description:
Sobre a empresa:

Uma indústria de ideias a serviço do progresso.
Liderança. Confiança. Expertise.

Fundada em 1954 com o objetivo inicial de atuar nas áreas de investigação e sondagem de solos, a Sondotécnica foi, ao longo do tempo, ampliando sua gama de serviços, passando a oferecer estudos de barragens e ingressou na consultoria para a construção de hidrelétricas. Foi pioneira nas áreas de hidrologia, oceanografia e transporte de sedimentos, também adquiriu conhecimento de estruturas, elaborando projetos de edifícios, complexos industriais e até pontes. Com o forte investimento em pesquisa, treinamento e qualificação, a empresa diversificou sua área de atuação e hoje presta serviços em vários segmentos de infraestrutura, com foco na execução dos projetos, gerenciamento, fiscalização e supervisão de obras. A Sondotécnica hoje é líder em consultoria de engenharia no Brasil, com mais de 3 mil projetos executados e mais de 400 clientes atendidos. Hoje, a Sondotécnica oferece sua expertise para empreendimentos nos setores de: – Transporte – Saneamento – Habitação – Urbanização – Energia – Indústria – Meio Ambiente – Irrigação.

Sobre a vaga

  • Auxílio no dimensionamento e detalhamento de projetos de estruturas de contenção, aterros sobre solos moles, estabilidade de taludes de solos e rochosos, fundações e estruturas enterradas, instrumentação, rebaixamento de lençol freático;
  • Programação, acompanhamento, controle de medição e interpretação de investigações geológico-geotécnicas;

Requisitos:

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We'll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account ). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

Fundada em 1954 com o objetivo inicial de atuar nas áreas de investigação e sondagem de solos, a Sondotécnica foi, ao longo do tempo, ampliando sua gama de serviços, passando a oferecer estudos de barragens e ingressou na consultoria para a construção de hidrelétricas. Foi pioneira nas áreas de hidrologia, oceanografia e transporte de sedimentos, também adquiriu conhecimento de estruturas, elaborando projetos de edifícios, complexos industriais e até pontes. Com o forte investimento em pesquisa, treinamento e qualificação, a empresa diversificou sua área de atuação e hoje presta serviços em vários segmentos de infraestrutura, com foco na execução dos projetos, gerenciamento, fiscalização e supervisão de obras. A Sondotécnica hoje é líder em consultoria de engenharia no Brasil, com mais de 3 mil projetos executados e mais de 400 clientes atendidos. Hoje, a Sondotécnica oferece sua expertise para empreendimentos nos setores de: – Transporte – Saneamento – Habitação – Urbanização – Energia – Indústria – Meio Ambiente – Irrigação.

title: Bid Manager
description:
Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward—we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

Manages new and renewal business opportunities related to managed, major and/or complex solutions. Plays an active part in the entire proposal project life cycle, challenge solutions and drive best practice for major or complex deals. Ensures that SITA is portrayed professionally and with credibility

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Validates the qualification of opportunities and monitors qualification status at all stages during the bid process.
  • Analyses and understands the customer's detailed requirements in order to develop the optimum win strategy and associated appropriate level of response in order to successfully bid and win each contract.
  • Develops the overall bid project plan and builds and manages the virtual Bid Team to achieve the bid deliverables in an effective and efficient manner. This includes leading the process of identifying potential subcontractors or partners and selecting / negotiating / contracting with such parties under the guidance of senior regional / commercial management.
  • Owns and reviews the overall response to customer, assessing the risk to delivering a successful bid project, and ensuring that these are addressed appropriately under the guidance of senior regional / commercial management.
  • Coordinates the negotiation team in the pre-contract stage with the Customer, including the setting up of appropriate commercial partnership agreements and underpinning contracts to support contract deliverables whilst ensuring that the relevant internal expertise is involved in the closure of commercial, financial and legal issues with the customer.
  • Develops plans to ensure a smooth transition from the bid team to the delivery and implementation team upon contract award, including comprehensive and clear documentation of all aspects of the solution.
  • Helps obtains solution approvals (financial, technical etc) and ensures the proposed solution is carried out in accordance with the appropriate corporate guidelines.
  • Communicates progress regularly and clearly to the relevant SITA senior management and stakeholders, ensuring that major issues are escalated and addressed.
Qualifications

WHO YOU ARE 

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional qualifications in Economics, Business Administration, Finance or Legal.
  • Verifiable 5 + years of experience in commercial or similar roles with strong project management skills across multiple teams in multiple locations is required
  • Must have Proposal Management, Sales, Business Development or Account Management experience.
  • Experience in aviation industry or IT is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience and verifiable experience in complex bids & proposals - in purchasing and/or sales - including exposure to the vendor side.
  • Relevant understanding of the airport and/or airline operation is an advantage.
  • Experience in developing successful relationships at Senior Manager level.
  • Preferably having worked in a multinational company.  

WHAT WE OFFER

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.

Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning

Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

title: Digital Catalog Strategy Sr Manager
description:
